scope: Selected Small IN100 feature-preparation and baseline-measurement pilot filters only; this is not a coverage inventory of OrientationAnalysis or SimplnxCore.

filters.purpose: Segment finite-sample EBSD features without periodic face wrapping.
Locate final reconstructed features from observed voxel centers.
Measure voxel counts, physical volumes, and equivalent diameters.
Measure fitted shape descriptors using final IDs and centroids.
Export direct feature arrays with traceable Feature_ID rows.
